verdicts.reason: Both crops lose the key imagery: the heart mug and red gift are cut to slivers at the right edge. In A, the 'A GIFT' headline and the dashed dividers run onto the sweater photo, so text sits on a busy image. A also has a stray rule floating under LYGOM CAFE, oversized stars and a large dead gap above 'Only this Christmas'. B keeps all text on the pink field with clean hierarchy, but its type is undersized for the tall format (the website and 'Only this Christmas' are small). B also has extra detached divider lines around the tagline and wastes space at top and bottom.
